newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indah notes, yen bond rated BB- by S&P.
newsitem.headline: Indah notes, yen bond rated BB- by S&P.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Wednesday it had assigned a BB- rating to Indah Kiat Finance Mauritius Ltd's $500 million guaranteed senior notes due 2007 and has raised its rating on Indah Kiat International Finance Co. B.V.'s 37 billion yen unsecured bonds due 2000 to BB- from B+.
S&P said it also affirmed its BB corporate credit rating on Indah Kiat, and its BB rating on Indah Kiat's and its guaranteed subsidiary Indah Kiat International Finance Co. B.V's secured bonds.
The outlook on Indah Kiat is stable, S&P said.
It said in a statement that the rating reflects Indah Kiat's very competitive pulp operations built on low-cost fibre and labour resources.

It also said the rating reflects the company's leading market position in the growing Indonesian and regional Asian economies, efficient operating plant, and a high level of operational integration within the Asia Pulp & Paper Co. Ltd (APP) group.
